methodology: Competitive in-match penalties are treated separately from penalty shootouts.
Shootout-only evidence is excluded from hierarchy decisions.
A penalty taken while the filed primary was absent establishes backup capability but does not by itself promote that player.
Unsupported recommended positions are null rather than inferred from absence.
Official club, league and competition sources are preferred over specialist, media and community sources.

verdict_definitions.KEEP: The complete filed hierarchy remains the recommended hierarchy.
verdict_definitions.REVIEW: The filed primary remains recommended, but at least one lower position needs review.
verdict_definitions.CHANGE_CANDIDATE: The recommended primary differs from the filed primary, or an empty filed row can now be populated.
verdict_definitions.UNRESOLVED: No defensible current primary was identified.

source_tier_definitions.TIER_1_OFFICIAL: Official club, Premier League, UEFA or direct manager evidence.
source_tier_definitions.TIER_2_SPECIALIST_MEDIA: Specialist set-piece source or reliable national or local media.
source_tier_definitions.TIER_3_SUPPORTING: Transfermarkt history or community lead used only as supporting evidence.
